card.name: Words after negation or contrast
card.fires_on: Words right after a negating word like not or no longer, or inside terms about decrease or sparing. The marked word is often the next link, such as as, by, or because.

modes.label: After 'not'
modes.description: A linking word directly after not, setting up a contrast like 'not X but Y'.
modes.example: mentality which considers the human being not<< as>> a person but as a thing

modes.description: Partway through medical words meaning reduce or spare.
modes.example: co-administration with clonidine may inhibit<< cl>>onidine’s anti-hypertensive

modes.description: Words like because or reason in opinion text criticizing something.
